name: githubspace
description: Personal DSH workspace repository, packaged as an installable plugin bundle.

summary.en: Installs the personal githubspace workspace repository as a manageable DSH bundle; it ships the bundle shell only.
summary.zh: 把个人 githubspace 工作区仓库作为可管理的 DSH 组合包装载；当前仅提供组合包骨架，没有运行时组件。
